correctness.rationale: John candidate Q has diagonal d/(d+1)^2 equal squared center coordinate, giving nonnegative coordinates; axial inequality implies ||x||²<=1. d+1 contact points form normalized regular simplex with zero barycenter and covariance I/d, sufficient for unique John maximality. Löwner candidate unit-sphere gauge q(z) is strictly convex in z=e·omega∈[1/sqrt d,1], with both endpoints gauge one; interior is strictly inside. Origin has gauge <=1 and equals one for d=3,4,5, strictly <1 for d>=6. Explicit positive weights for contact sets give center and covariance Q/d; contact certificate gives unique covering ellipsoid. Independently recomputed Q/covariance identities for d=3,4,5,6,7,10,20 (max numerical error 2.8e-17), and origin gauges 1 through d=5, 0.9439 at d=6. All-dimensional claim rests on exact algebra, not finite checks.
